title: Kanmani Anbudan
episodeTitle: Sivagami Offers Kanmani a New Idea
description: Sivagami suggests Kanmani start a business selling her homemade health mix powder. Anbu tries to disturb her sleep by singing, but Kanmani ignores him with earbuds.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman spots Ilamathi's scooty with a stranger and tracks her down. Kalamma learns of Siddharth's dark past and sends goons, but Ilamathi signals Paraman for help.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Prabhakaran and Abinaya appear in court despite the missing evidence against Karna. Divakar challenges Prabhakaran, alleging that Abinaya is trying to protect Karna.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar asks Shruthi to forget her brother despite her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Thangaraj anxiously awaits his mother's blood test results, which the doctor confirms are normal.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Meena asks Pandian not to scold Senthil in public. Later, Saravanan, Palanivel, Kathir, and Senthil tail Karthikeyan to check his character.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nadesan questions Sembaruthi about their past love at her shop. Later, he goes missing as Nila's family prepares for Bihar, prompting Pandian to search for him.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj urges Rohini to abort the pregnancy, leaving her distressed and causing her to faint. Meena is moved when Muthu selects a costly gold wedding chain for their remarriage.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi tearfully celebrates Meenatchi's 1st birthday with family. Tamizhselvi is crushed when Azhagar calls Aishwarya Amma.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Karthik and Kasthuri Tie the Knot
description: Kasthuri's grandfather pressures Karthik into marrying her while she is unconscious. Kasthuri regains consciousness and realises the forced marriage, leaving Karthik helpless.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
episodeTitle: Murugan Leads the Team to Victory
description: Facing a player shortage, Murugan joins the Kabaddi team and helps win the trophy. Kandhasamy confronts him after discovering his secret Biryani business.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Extreme Personalities Audition
description: Baby Prabhakaran and Ranjith impress the judges with their natural charm and unusual talents. However, Priyavarshini and Nivya Maran end up disappointing them.
